sections.title: Fun time
sections.text:
Great inventions around us
People invent things to solve problems. Great inventions are everywhere around us.
The wheel: In ancient times, it was hard to carry heavy things or travel around. Ancient people invented wheels. And the wheel changes the world.
Printing: Long ago, people could only copy books by hand. Around 1041, Bi Sheng invented movable-type printing. With this invention, we can print books much more quickly today.
Traffic lights: More than a hundred years ago, there were lots of accidents at road crossings. Thanks to the traffic lights, crossing roads became much safer.
In our everyday life, there are many other great inventions, such as televisions and robots.

Sound or important.
The book tells short stories about forty inventions. These important inventions are for farmers and workers.

sections.title: Talking time
sections.text:
Welcome, boys and girls! It’s our Science Day. We have Mr Qian with us to talk about some new inventions.
Hi, I’ve got some interesting things to tell you today. Look, this invention is very useful.
You pour in sea water and let the sun do the work for a few hours. Then you have clean fresh water!
How nice!
Look, these are also great inventions from Chinese scientists. In 2019, they explored the ‘dark’ side of the moon.
Oh, Chang’e-4 and Yutu-2.
They took amazing photos and sent them back.
Yes. We know so little about that part of the moon and it’s important to find out more.
Find the rule: It’s important to find out more. It’s important to make new inventions. It’s important to understand why wheels were invented.

sections.title: Reading time
sections.text:
The wheel moves on
The wheel is an old invention. It dates back to over 5,000 years ago.
Now we can find wheels almost everywhere around us. For example, there are wheels at home, in the street and in the classroom.
We can find wheels in a clock, an electric fan, a juicer and a washing machine. We can find wheels on a bus, a bike, a train and an airplane. Sometimes we can also find wheels on chairs or desks.
The wheel is one of the most important inventions. Wheels make housework much easier. Wheels help people travel around easily and comfortably. And wheels help people carry heavy things.
Thanks to the wheel, we are able to save time and work to make more inventions.
